sources.entry: iChm - Ebook reader for CHM (Microsoft Compiled HTML help) files. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/NSGod/ichm) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: iChm is a Cocoa-based CHM (Microsoft Compiled HTML Help) file reader for Mac OS X.
summary.what_it_does: iChm opens Microsoft Compiled HTML Help (.chm) files on Mac OS X. It provides tabbed browsing, a table of contents that auto-locates the current document, and an index with find-by-index. It offers full-text search across the CHM file, sorted by relevance, plus find-in-page. Users can switch text encoding, zoom text, navigate back, forward and home, and add tag-based bookmarks. The whole file can also be exported to PDF. The README says the interface is localized in Chinese, German, Spanish and Dutch.
use_cases: Read CHM help files on a Mac
Search inside a compiled help document
Export a CHM help file to PDF
Browse offline Windows help manuals on macOS
Bookmark sections of a CHM ebook
how_to_run: Build requires at least Xcode 5.1 on OS X 10.9 (Mavericks), per the developer notes
Optional: add a diff textconv entry to ~/.gitconfig for Localizable .strings files
notable: Fully built with Cocoa, with no custom window rendering
Full-text search over the CHM file, automatically sorted by relevance
Export whole CHM file to PDF
caveats: README requires Mac OS X 10.6 or above; for Mac OS X 10.5, the README points to iChm 1.4.3
Building from source needs Xcode 5.1 or later on OS X 10.9 or later
The README mentions a separate iPhone/iPod Touch version on the App Store, which is not part of this repository
